cards.headline: The song that led off Cupid Deluxe
cards.snippet: In November 2013, British musician Dev Hynes, who records as Blood Orange and is based in New York City, released his second Blood Orange album, Cupid Deluxe. Three singles promoted it: "Chamakay", "You're Not Good Enough" and "Uncle ACE". The record featured guest appearances from David Longstreth of Dirty Projectors, Caroline Polachek of Chairlift, Skepta and others. Hynes streamed the full album on his own YouTube channel on 5 November 2013.
cards.context: Cupid Deluxe also featured guests like Caroline Polachek, David Longstreth and Skepta.

cards.headline: Cover star the month the album landed
cards.snippet: In late 2013, as Cupid Deluxe came out, The FADER put Blood Orange, the project of Dev Hynes, on the cover of its 2013-14 Now Issue, which reached newsstands on December 10th. Writer Alex Frank followed Hynes around New York, from Bushwick to the top of the Empire State Building, to look at his DIY take on pop. To mark the cover, Hynes also made a downloadable mix compiling influences from the new album.
cards.context: The issue also came with a mix by Blood Orange compiling influences from Cupid Deluxe.

cards.headline: Loved her before knowing who she was
cards.snippet: Why did I never know that was Caroline??? Damn. I love when I learn later about an artist, then realize I had loved them before without knowing
cards.context: Caroline Polachek, formerly of Chairlift, sings on the track.

cards.headline: Found out the video was shot in their homeland

cards.headline: A warning for hot summer days
cards.snippet: If this song gets played on a hot summer day after a few drinks,.,... WATCH OUT!   Someone's  bout to git some lovin'.
cards.context: A joke about how seductive the track is.

cards.headline: Blood Orange live at Coachella 2014, with Caroline Polachek
cards.snippet: Recorded on 13 April 2014 during Coachella's first weekend, this live take features Caroline Polachek alongside Blood Orange. One listener: "One of my fondest memories of Coachella ‘14. His set was amazing. Great vibes."

cards.snippet: Caroline Polachek and Dev Hynes share the stage for this live performance at Terminal 5 on 2 December 2021, billed under both their names.
